column1: # Armoury catalogue overrides: culture and category for names the parser cannot resolve.
# An override must record a DECISION. A row that writes back `unknown` is
# REJECTED by the loader with a warning: seeding 206 such rows on 2026-09-01
# satisfied the gate's predicate while recording nothing, which turned the
# gate into a blanket waiver over 178 live, item-referenced assets.
# Keys are the ESCAPED mesh name, exactly as the catalogue stores it. A
# NUL-bearing name must be written by escape(), never hand-typed: a
# hand-typed backslash-x-0-0 and a real NUL byte look identical in an editor
# The list is bounded and genuinely small: 802 unresolved on the first run,
# 206 after the vocabulary was extracted from the live names, 3 once the
# parser learned to split on whitespace, strip trailing indexes and read
# Rohan's abbreviations: two proper names and one corrupt export. The corrupt
# dwarf beard name (8 NUL bytes) is no longer in the catalogue, and the same
# tpac now ships sk_dwarf_beard_a_10, so its row went on 2026-10-14.
# Since then, creature meshes the vocabulary does not name (elk, Animalia) and
# the lord's material bars, which have no armour slot.
